response.text: Invoice 605 is open (no payment), and its journal credit of 1932.77 is lower than the invoice amount of 1950.77, so the two disagree by 18.00.

findings.evidence_sql: select h."JRNL_NO", sum(l."DR_AMT") dr, sum(l."CR_AMT") cr from "GLJRNH" h join "GLJRNL" l on l."JRNL_NO"=h."JRNL_NO" group by 1 having sum(l."DR_AMT")<>sum(l."CR_AMT")
findings.summary: Journal 1597 (invoice V0006-58310-357) debits 5400 for 14,689.28 but credits AP 2000 for 14,644.28; out of balance by 45.00.

findings.evidence_sql: select i."INV_ID", i."INV_AMT", x.dr, x.cr2000 from "APINVH" i join (select "JRNL_NO", sum("DR_AMT") dr, sum(case when trim("ACCT_CD")='2000' then "CR_AMT" else 0 end) cr2000 from "GLJRNL" group by 1) x on x."JRNL_NO"=i."JRNL_NO" where i."INV_ID"=357 and (x.dr<>i."INV_AMT" or x.cr2000<>i."INV_AMT")
findings.summary: Invoice 357 INV_AMT 14,644.28 (and its payment) disagrees with the journal 1597 expense debit of 14,689.28 (the AP credit agrees with the invoice).

findings.evidence_sql: select i."INV_ID", i."INV_AMT", x.dr, x.cr from "APINVH" i join (select "JRNL_NO", sum("DR_AMT") dr, sum("CR_AMT") cr from "GLJRNL" group by 1) x on x."JRNL_NO"=i."JRNL_NO" where i."INV_ID"=605 and x.cr<>i."INV_AMT"
findings.summary: Invoice 605 (V0010-85476-605) has INV_AMT 1,950.77 but its journal 2000 records 1,932.77 on both debit and credit (a balanced journal that differs from the invoice by 18.00). The invoice is still open.

findings.evidence_sql: select h."JRNL_NO", h."PRD_ID", h."POST_DT", p."END_DT", p."CLOSE_DT", p."STAT_CD" from "GLJRNH" h join "GLPERD" p on p."PRD_ID"=h."PRD_ID" where p."STAT_CD"='C' and h."POST_DT">p."CLOSE_DT"
findings.summary: Journals 2468 (period 7, posted 2024-08-26) and 2469 (period 5, posted 2024-06-18) are assigned to closed periods but their posting dates fall outside the period and after the period's CLOSE_DT.
